LanguageData.VFEI2_AcidImmunity.description: Insectoids from the Kemia geneline are immune to acid.
LanguageData.VFEI2_AcidImmunity.label: acid immunity
LanguageData.VFEI2_ArmorDegradation.description: The armor of this insectoid has been cracked and lost part of its efficiency.
LanguageData.VFEI2_ArmorDegradation.label: armor degradation
LanguageData.VFEI2_EmpressSpawn.description: A gestating, insectoid spawn. Starting from a small egg, it will quickly absorb nutrients and grow, slowly causing more pain to the host. It will quickly take control of the nervous system, grow, and extend throughout the host's body until it is ready to emerge through the rib cage, ultimately killing the host. During its growth, the spawn absorbs memories of the host, which will make the insectoid friendly to your colony.
LanguageData.VFEI2_EmpressSpawn.label: empress spawn
LanguageData.VFEI2_EmpressSpawn.stages.0.label: egg
LanguageData.VFEI2_EmpressSpawn.stages.1.label: larva
LanguageData.VFEI2_EmpressSpawn.stages.2.label: pupa
LanguageData.VFEI2_EmpressSpawn.stages.3.label: juvenile

LanguageData.VFEI2_RoyalJellyAddiction.description: A chemical addiction to royal jelly. Regular consumption of royal jelly has caused immunological adaptations at the genetic level, so the immune system can no longer function properly without the drug. Whenever an infection happen, the addicted person will not be able to overcome it without royal jelly. However, extended abstinence will force the immune system to adapt back to its normal state, resolving the addiction.
LanguageData.VFEI2_RoyalJellyAddiction.label: royal jelly addiction
LanguageData.VFEI2_RoyalJellyAddiction.stages.0.label: addicted
LanguageData.VFEI2_RoyalJellyAddiction.stages.1.label: withdrawal

LanguageData.VFEI2_ToxicBuildup.description: Toxins in the bloodstream. This can come from various sources, including environmental toxins, venomous bites, or poisoned weapons. \nAt high doses, toxic buildup is lethal. Even at low doses, it can generate cancers. \nContrary to base game toxic buildup, creatures who die with this toxic damage can be eaten.
